messages.en:
Why have I gotta be the
one that's always doing the
talking? {0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}Maybe a visitor from
another town will be a 
little more chatty.
messages.et:
Miks pean mina alati olema
see, kes räägib?
{0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}Ehk on külaline teisest
linnast pisut 
jutukam.

messages.en:
Back when I lived in
{ff 00 00 08}{04 18 00}{ff 00 00 00}, I knew this
kid named {ff 00 00 05}{04 19 00}{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 0e 00}How many days has it been
days since we hung out?
{04 0f 00}?
{07 14 00}I'll bet that kid is still
a total {04 11 00}!
messages.et:
Kui ma elasin veel
{ff 00 00 08}{04 18 00}{ff 00 00 00}-s, tundsin ma
last nimega {ff 00 00 05}{04 19 00}{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 0e 00}Mitu päeva on möödas
sellest, kui koos aega
veetsime? {04 0f 00}?
{07 14 00}Vean kihla, et see laps on
ikka täielik {04 11 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Do you have any friends
you never really forget,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}I remember this kid named
{ff 00 00 05}{04 19 00}{ff 00 00 00}. Ahhh...the
memories.
The last time we bumped
into each other was over in
{ff 00 00 08}{04 18 00}{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 1b 00}Something about that kid
was so "{04 11 00}."{01 00 00 05 00}
That kid was a character!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Kas sul on sõpru, keda
sa kunagi ei unusta,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Ma mäletan üht last nimega
{ff 00 00 05}{04 19 00}{ff 00 00 00}. Ahhh...need
mälestused.
Viimane kord, kui me
teineteisele otsa jooksime,
oli {ff 00 00 08}{04 18 00}{ff 00 00 00}-s.
{07 1b 00}Selles lapses oli midagi
nii „{04 11 00}”.{01 00 00 05 00}
See laps oli tegelane!

messages.en:
{01 00 00 05 00}So yeah, maybe I AM a 
big grouch.

{07 17 00}But when someone says
"{ff 00 00 02}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}" to me,
I melt into a total softie!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}And you know what? My
friend from another town
said just that to me!
messages.et:
{01 00 00 05 00}Nii et jah, ehk OLEN ma 
suur torisev vanamees.

{07 17 00}Aga kui keegi ütleb mulle
„{ff 00 00 02}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}”,
sulan ma täiesti pehmeks!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Ja tead mida? Mu sõber
teisest linnast ütles
mulle just seda!

messages.en:
I don't usually brag, but
{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 17 00}don't I make you think
"{ff 00 00 02}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}"?
What? You don't think so, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}? {07 01 00}You got a 
lotta nerve, {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Ma tavaliselt ei kiitle, aga
{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 17 00}kas sa ei mõtle minust
„{ff 00 00 02}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}”?
Mis? Sa ei arva nii, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}? {07 01 00}Sul on alles 
jultumust, {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Oh!{01 00 00 0f 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 00 00}You know 
that friend of yours that's
crashing at your place?
Yeah, {ff 00 00 05}{04 19 00}{ff 00 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} That
kid sent me this letter.
{01 00 00 05 00}Kinda weird, right?

{07 15 00}Every time I read this
letter, I see that.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}face.

Maybe it's kinda sappy,{01 00 00 05 00}
but I can hear that kid's
voice when I read it.
{07 08 00}Man, letters are great, 
aren't they, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Iga kord, kui ma seda kirja
loen, näen ma seda.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}nägu.

Ehk on see pisut nutune,{01 00 00 05 00}
aga ma kuulen selle lapse
häält, kui ma seda loen.
{07 08 00}Poiss, kirjad on vahvad, 
kas pole, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Heh.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 17 00}Sorry if I creeped
you out there.

{07 00 00}When I got this letter, I 
didn't care so much about
what it said, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0a 00}What matters is that
{ff 00 00 05}{04 19 00} {ff 00 00 00}took the time
to write me.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kui ma selle kirja sain, ei 
hoolinud ma eriti sellest,
mis seal seisis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0a 00}Tähtis on see, et
{ff 00 00 05}{04 19 00} {ff 00 00 00}võttis aega
mulle kirjutada.
